newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-SHQIPONJA PULLS OUT OF RESUMED ALBANIAN LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHQIPONJA PULLS OUT OF RESUMED ALBANIAN LEAGUE.

text.p: Shqiponja have pulled out of the second stage of the Albanian league because of financial difficulties, soccer officials said on Monday.
Gjergj Thaka of the Albanian soccer federation said the club told them "they could not finance the trips to the venues where their matches are to be held,"
Thaka said no solution had been reached.
The second stage of the 1996-97 league, which was suspended in February due to armed civil unrest, resumed on Saturday after the government guaranteed adequate security in the stadiums.
The new season is scheduled to begin on September 13.
Albanian clubs have been suspended by UEFA from the 1997-98 Cup competitions, but the national side will play a World Cup group nine home qualifier against Northern Ireland in Spain on September 10.
